# Producer, predicate and completion relation

A covariant unary producer binds one Object method formal. A predicate consumes
that value and a nested completion of Boolean; a final completion consumes the
same original item. Original Object results, Boolean casts/unboxing, nulls,
miss sentinels, wide boxed values, reads, callbacks and failure state are audited
by frozen callers. All original Signatures, Exceptions and metadata remain
unchanged. Owned and dependency configurations run sixty cases with two
attempts before and after recovery; four independent wrong programs must fail.

The `--fixed-completion` variant copies the sources into a fresh directory and
changes the final completion to the same fixed Boolean type used by the nested
completion. The produced input remains an independent method formal. Frozen
callers distinguish arbitrary input/result objects from true, false and null
completion values and retain all ordered effects, failures and late casts. Both
owned and imported declarations run 60 cases twice and compare all original
metadata; a fifth wrong program loses the final completion value.
